friction.problem: Pinned Substrate workers used SPIFFE Actor certificates, while the installed egress gateway required the removed ActorIdentity extension. The first model turn failed before tools with reset connections.
friction.evidence: Worker atunnel CONNECT403: actor certificate has no ActorIdentity. Same-Actor model-free TLS/HTTPS probes failed before and passed after the image-only fix.
friction.resolution: Updated only the owned egress gateway to the verified official compatible image; details and upstream references are in substrate-gke-2026-10-29.json.

friction.problem: The next model turn searched capability directories for its CSV until the600s bound. Input paths were only in standing instructions; workspace.copy also ran on the host after the guest worktree upload, leaving selected inputs absent in copied guests.
friction.resolution: One bounded metadata index is linked in the actual native prompt and copied with selected immutable bytes. Declared copies are staged before the first guest upload.
friction.hermetic_evidence: The native-prompt regression failed before its hint; a copied fake Substrate native tool then failed to find the index before the transport fix. All3 focused regressions pass, with source SHA256, artifact BLAKE3, hostile metadata, unrelated-source exclusion, digest mismatch rejection and index-size coverage.
friction.live_evidence: The first corrected native tool opened the exact /workspace/.console-inputs/.../INDEX.md, then the source; one Python command wrote the output and manifest. The main operation settled in about33s.

friction.problem: A queued operation can settle while the harness has no valid deliverable, so operation state alone is insufficient acceptance evidence.
friction.resolution: Qualification checked native result_event/result_error, captured producer/turn, downloaded bytes, computed values and explicit current-revision acceptance.
